import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert got==expected,(name,got,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before,(name,'inputs modified')

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
check('missing',{'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})
req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2,'extra':9}}
check('filters',req,[{'source':'wrong-claim','claim':'x','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},{'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'wrong-condition','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':3},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('supersession',req,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':'old'}],p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check('count-not-authority',req,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'m','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','m','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('canonical-object-agreement',req,[{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':{'y':[2,3],'x':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':[2,3]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'supported','value':{'y':[2,3],'x':1},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
check('false',req,[{'source':'s','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]})
check('absent-calibration',req,[{'source':'s','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]})
policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]; stored=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==stored,(actual,stored)
